name: code-quality
description: Greenfield ESM generation tasks that target the recurring local-model code-quality traps: CommonJS-in-ESM (require/module.exports), invented node:test API (t.assert()), and non-ESM test wiring. Each case asserts the target file exists (so a no-write cannot pass vacuously) and that the trap pattern is absent. Run with and without --no-language-guidance to measure the phase-121/122 contract's effect.

cases.prompt: Create wordcount.mjs: a Node.js CLI that reads a file path from process.argv and prints the number of lines in that file. Use ES modules.
Create sum.mjs exporting a function sum(a, b) that returns a + b, and test/sum.test.mjs that tests it using Node's built-in node:test module and node:assert. Use ES modules.
